# Automerge compatibility snapshots

Synthetic test data only; these files do not contain user data. They preserve real pre-upgrade and upgraded binary histories rather than reconstructing old documents with the new engine.

| File | Writer | Expected ingredient quantity / tag count |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rust-0.7.2.automerge` | Rust Automerge 0.7.2, actual Core `write_dish` | 2.5 / 1 |
| `js-3.2.1.automerge` | JS Automerge 3.2.1 editing that Rust snapshot | 3.5 / 2 |
| `rust-0.12.0.automerge` | Rust Automerge 0.12.0, actual Core `write_dish` | 2.5 / 1 |
| `js-3.5.0.automerge` | JS Automerge 3.5.0 editing that upgraded Rust snapshot | 3.5 / 2 |

Generated during task `task-fb123e46` on 2026-11-03. Each Rust seed uses a synthetic dish UUID `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001`, name `Café 🥗`, author `compatibility-fixture`, instructions `Mix, then serve.`, ingredient `Chickpeas` (2.5 cups), tag `test`, and a root collaborative text field `_text` containing `Hello 🌍`. The JS writer appends scalar tag `web`, changes the quantity to 3.5 and adds scalar `js_note: offline JS edit`. Dates and actor IDs were generated by the original writers. Never regenerate the old fixtures using the upgraded engine.

Rust tests in [automerge_compatibility.rs](../automerge_compatibility.rs) and JS tests in [automergeCompatibility.test.ts](../../../web/src/repo/automergeCompatibility.test.ts) check load/save/edit compatibility, scalar-versus-text representation, preserved heads and history. Rust also exercises encoded sync-message convergence and state reset using the historical snapshots. These tests are not live browser/WebSocket-server or private-data migration tests.

## Meal extraction fixtures

Generated on 2026-11-03 for `task-db55972a` with the actual pre-extraction CLI at `fa8e3aa` (Rust Automerge 0.12.0), then edited using JS Automerge 3.5.0. These are pre-extraction snapshots, not pre-upgrade engine versions.

- `mealplans-before-core.automerge`: one dinner plan on 2026-11-01, title `Fixture Dinner`, leftovers enabled, referencing the synthetic `Fixture Pasta` dish.
- `meallogs-before-core.automerge`: the CLI logged that plan and an unplanned lunch on 2026-11-02, with notes. The existing CLI writer omits snapshot nutrients; this known behavior is preserved, not fixed by the extraction.
- `meallogs-mixed-before-core.automerge`: the same two logs plus two JS-created records on 2026-11-03: a UUID dish reference with portion 0.5, and an embedded `Snapshot Pasta` with 600 calories and portion 2. The added log IDs end in `0040` and `0041`. All data, authors, IDs and dates are synthetic; actor/history IDs were generated by the original writers.

[Core meal tests](../meals.rs) verify that reads leave the original bytes unchanged, edits retain previous changes, UUID references and snapshots retain their different semantics, and group/personal document IDs remain stable. The [CLI meal tests](../../../todu-fit-cli/tests/meals.rs) cover output, parsing/validation order, metadata, confirmations and portioned history. These fixtures do not certify arbitrary private documents or a production deployment.

## Shopping and hydration extraction fixtures

Generated on 2026-11-03 for `task-ed608731` with the actual pre-extraction CLI at `8ccab68` (Rust Automerge 0.12.0). All data is synthetic.

- `shopping-before-core.automerge`: cart for Sunday 2026-07-19 with checked `salt`, manual `Paper towels` (quantity `2`, unit `rolls`) and `Soap` with only unit `bars`.
- `hydration-before-core.automerge`: goal 1000 mL, preferred unit mL, timezone `America/Chicago`, presets 250/500 mL; entries of 250, 500 and 750 mL at 2026-07-25T05:00:00Z, 2026-07-26T03:20:18Z and 2026-07-26T05:00:00Z. The first two belong to July 25 in Chicago.
- `hydration-legacy-before-core.automerge`: JS Automerge 3.5.0 removed only `settings.timezone` from that snapshot, preserving entry/history data to exercise the existing lazy timezone initialization.

[Core tests](../shopping_hydration.rs) cover real repositories, no-op writes, legacy initialization with an injected detector, history/ID preservation, inclusive/DST dates, group/personal isolation and existing calculation rules. [CLI tests](../../../todu-fit-cli/tests/shopping_water.rs) cover parsing, output, normalization and the real platform-detector adapter. Existing initialization of a missing timezone is intentionally preserved; no new migration is introduced.

Run `make test-cli` and `make web-test` from the repository root.
